_comment: Warmup-frame text bboxes for R1's Gate (reports/2026-07-03-glyph-r1-cache-driven-detection.md section 4a). Frames are drawn from each qualifying game's OWN probe-dir recording (runs/probe_*/world/, NOT tracked in this worktree -- resolved against a caller-supplied --probe-root, e.g. the main checkout), EXCLUDING every frame byte-identical (MD5) to a labels.json fixture frame (mechanically checked by eval/score_glyph_r1.py, never assumed). 'targets' bboxes here are loose text-block boxes (same drawing convention as labels.json) used ONLY to seed simulated cache confirmations (core.text_regions_r1.confirm_region, single shared placeholder reading) -- they are NOT scored directly; scoring reuses labels.json's own targets. Up to 5 text-bearing frames per qualifying game, per the pinned bar; a game with fewer than 5 in its probe dir (measured: Mortal Kombat Advance has only 4 total warmup candidates after MD5 exclusion) cannot qualify and is omitted here.

excluded.Mortal Kombat Advance: measured 2026-07-11: only 4 warmup candidates remain after MD5-excluding labels.json's 7 labeled frames from the 14-frame probe dir (< the pinned >= 5 text-bearing-frame floor) -- cannot qualify regardless of content. NOTE: the design doc's own section-4a table estimated 7 candidates via raw count subtraction (14-7); the real MD5-mechanical count is lower because 2 groups of intra-probe duplicate frames (frame_000003/4/5 and frame_000007/8/9, byte-identical within each group) each collapse to a single exclusion once one member matches a labeled frame's hash. Measured, not assumed -- see eval/score_glyph_r1.py's own --probe-root run for the receipts.
excluded.Naruto: Ninja Council 2: excluded per the design doc itself: only 2 labeled Gate-1 target-bearing frames (< the pinned >= 3 floor).
